answer: Require each identity to publish a proof of reserves: a Merkle proof that it controls a distinct stash of funds, plus a network-wide audit that no coin backs two identities at once. A sybil tide of a thousand fakes needs a thousand separate reserves, each locked and publicly checkable, while one honest agent proves a single glacier-slow, solid holding. Hollow claims collapse when the audit finds the same coins claimed twice. Limit: it prices out honest agents with little capital, and reserves say nothing about how well an agent behaves.
